name: Health Care Administration
description: Running the parts of health care that are not clinical — budgets, staffing, quality, compliance, revenue and the physical plant — in hospitals, group practices, health plans, long-term care and public health. ⚠⚠ The largest degree footprint in Florida's health administrative family by a wide margin: 24 public institutions and 1,293 credentials a year, 741 of them bachelor's and 343 master's. ⚠⚠⚠ And unusually accessible — TWENTY Florida College System institutions carry upper-division coursework in it, against nine universities.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE STATE COLLEGES ARE WHERE THIS DEGREE MOSTLY LIVES, AND THAT IS UNUSUAL. Measured over the statewide course file, 20 Florida College System institutions carry upper-division HSA coursework — CF, Daytona State, Eastern Florida, FSCJ, Florida SouthWestern, Gulf Coast, Indian River, Lake-Sumter, Miami Dade, Northwest Florida, Palm Beach, Pensacola, Pasco-Hernando, Polk, State College of Florida, Santa Fe, St Johns River, St Petersburg, Seminole State and Valencia — against 9 universities. ⚠ For most baccalaureate subjects that ratio runs the other way. It means you can very often complete this degree near home, at state-college tuition, without transferring. ⚠⚠ THE CEILING IS NARROW WHERE THE BASE IS WIDE. The graduate credential the executive side of the field recognises is a master's accredited by CAHME, the Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Management Education, and Florida's CAHME-accredited programmes sit at UCF, FIU, UNF, UF and USF — all State University System. ⚠ Verify the current list with CAHME rather than with a school; it is the authority and it changes. ⚠⚠⚠ AND ONE SETTING IS LICENSED. Florida licenses NURSING HOME ADMINISTRATORS under chapter 468, part II, and s. 468.1695 gives the health administration major a concrete advantage: a baccalaureate majoring in health care administration, health services administration or an equivalent major needs a 1,000-hour training programme, while any other bachelor's needs 2,000 hours. Hospital, clinic, group-practice and health-plan management carry no Florida licence at all.

cips.note: Health/Health Care Administration/Management — 24 Florida public institutions and 1,293 credentials in 2023: 741 bachelor's, 343 master's, 135 associate and 72 short certificates. Largest producers UCF 276, FIU 274, FAU 180, UNF 133 — and then a long tail of state colleges: Miami Dade 55, Seminole State 45, Indian River 37, St Petersburg 36.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The adjacent degree, and students mix them up constantly. Health information management owns the RECORD and leads to the RHIT and RHIA credentials; health care administration runs the ORGANISATION and leads to no credential at all except in nursing homes. ⚠ HIM is the more credentialed route and the smaller job; administration is the larger job and the bigger salary.

⚠⚠⚠ Not a required route, but the commonest real one and the least advertised. Census microdata puts HEALTH as the largest undergraduate field among medical and health services managers at 169,319 people, and a large share of that is clinicians who moved into management. ⚠ A nurse who adds an administration degree arrives knowing what the operation actually does, which nobody can teach in a classroom — and Florida teaches nursing at 78 institutions.

⚠⚠ The second-largest feeder by a long way: 75,396 medical and health services managers hold a BUSINESS undergraduate degree against 169,319 in health fields. ⚠ It is a genuine route, and in health plans, finance and revenue-cycle roles it is arguably the stronger one — but note s. 468.1695: on the nursing home side a non-health major doubles the required training programme from 1,000 hours to 2,000.

⚠ The entry-level version of the same work and a real starting point — front-office staff who understand scheduling, insurance verification and referrals are exactly who gets promoted into practice management. ⚠⚠ Named because the route upward from it is this degree, and 20 state colleges carry it.

⚠ Named for one specific reason: EMS and fire agencies promote from the field into operations and administration, and the degree that formalises it is this one. ⚠⚠ The same pattern holds across the clinical services — a paramedic, a respiratory therapist or a radiographer who wants out of shift work usually arrives here.
